Baked here

Photos from the bakery’s Google listing.

A Lebanese oven in Larnaca

La Boulette bakery is on Ermou in Larnaca, in the Eleonora Hotel Apartments building, with a brick counter and an arched oven behind it. The logo says Est. 2021. Guests describe the food as freshly cooked and baked in front of you, recommend it for breakfast and lunch, and point out the vegan friendly choices. In the Google reviews Lebanese food is mentioned 13 times and the friendly owner 7 times.

Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Saturday from 8:00 to 19:00, Sunday from 8:00 to 14:00, closed on Wednesdays.

What guests say
